# PACE Technologies - metallographic.com

> Leading manufacturer of metallographic equipment and consumables for precision sample preparation since 1997, based in Tucson, Arizona.

## About PACE Technologies

PACE Technologies provides complete metallography lab solutions. The company manufactures precision abrasive cutters, wafering saws, compression and castable mounting presses, grinder-polishers, hardness testers (Rockwell, Vickers, Brinell, micro/macro), and metallurgical microscopes. PACE also manufactures a full range of consumables including polishing cloths, diamond suspensions, grinding papers, mounting resins, abrasive cutting blades, and etchants.

## Target Audience

Metallographers, materials scientists, quality control engineers, failure analysts, and materials research laboratories in aerospace, automotive, biomedical, electronics, and manufacturing industries.
